about: Real jarvis_history_import.view() answers, made by tools/gen_history_import_cases.py. Counts are made up.

cancelled.about: Jarvis reads only what you wrote in those chats - never the other assistant's replies - on this PC, with the AI model on this PC. Every possible fact waits under “Waiting for you” for your yes, one at a time; nothing is saved by itself. The chats are not added to your History. It can take hours for a big export, and Jarvis may answer more slowly while it runs.
